translations.idiomatic: In 1796 Fukang'an's pacification of the Miao won Fu Heng a posthumous beile rank.

sentences.zh: 福康安卒，推恩贈郡王銜，旋並命配享太廟。

translations.literal: When Fukang'an died, favor was extended to grant the posthumous rank of prince; soon he was also ordered to share sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: After Fukang'an's death the family was raised to princely rank and granted shared sacrifice in the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 傅恆直軍機處二十三年，日侍左右，以勤慎得上眷。

translations.literal: Fu Heng served in the Grand Council twenty-three years, daily attending at the emperor's side, and won imperial favor through diligence and caution.
translations.idiomatic: For twenty-three years Fu Heng served on the Grand Council at the emperor's side and won favor by diligence.

sentences.zh: 故事，軍機處諸臣不同入見，乾隆初，惟訥親承旨。

translations.literal: By precedent, grand councillors did not all enter audience together; in early Qianlong only Neqin received edicts.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent councillors did not all attend together; early in Qianlong only Neqin took edicts.

sentences.zh: 迨傅恆自陳不能多識，乞諸大臣同入見。

translations.literal: When Fu Heng said he could not remember much, he begged that all ministers enter audience together.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng said he could not remember enough and asked that all ministers attend together.

sentences.zh: 上晚膳後有所諮訪，又召傅恆獨對，時謂之「晚面」。

translations.literal: After the evening meal when the emperor had something to consult, he again summoned Fu Heng alone—this was called the 'evening audience.'
translations.idiomatic: After supper the emperor still summoned Fu Heng alone for consultation—the 'evening audience.'

sentences.zh: 又軍機處諸大臣既承旨，退自屬草，至傅恆始命章京具稿以進。

translations.literal: Also, after grand councillors received edicts they had drafted memorials themselves; from Fu Heng's time secretaries were first ordered to prepare drafts for submission.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly councillors drafted their own memorials after audience; Fu Heng had secretaries draft them first.

sentences.zh: 上倚傅恆為重臣，然偶有小節疏失，即加以戒約。

translations.literal: The emperor relied on Fu Heng as a great minister, yet if he slipped in small matters he was at once admonished.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor relied on Fu Heng but admonished even small slips.

sentences.zh: 傅恆益謙下，治事不敢自擅。

translations.literal: Fu Heng became all the more humble and in handling affairs did not dare act on his own.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng grew more humble and would not decide affairs alone.

sentences.zh: 敬禮士大夫，翼後進使盡其才。

translations.literal: He respected scholar-officials and helped juniors use their talents to the full.
translations.idiomatic: He honored scholars and helped younger men use their talents.

sentences.zh: 行軍與士卒同甘苦。

translations.literal: On campaign he shared hardship with the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign he shared the soldiers' hardships.

sentences.zh: 卒時未五十，上尤惜之。

translations.literal: He died before fifty; the emperor especially mourned him.
translations.idiomatic: He was not yet fifty when he died, and the emperor mourned him deeply.

sentences.zh: 子福靈安、福隆安、福康安、福長安。

translations.literal: His sons were Fuling'an, Fulong'an, Fukang'an, and Fuchang'an.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Fuling'an, Fulong'an, Fukang'an, and Fuchang'an.

sentences.zh: 福康安自有傳。

translations.literal: Fukang'an has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Fukang'an has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 福靈安，多羅額駙，授侍衛。

translations.literal: Fuling'an, a prince consort of the first degree, was appointed guard.
translations.idiomatic: Fuling'an, a prince consort, was made a guard.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾之役，從將軍兆惠戰於葉爾羌，有功，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the Dzungar campaign he followed General Zhaohui in battle at Yarkand, performed merit, and was granted the hereditary rank of yunqiwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dzungar war he fought with Zhaohui at Yarkand, earned merit, and received the hereditary rank yunqiwei.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，授正白旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he was appointed vice banner general of the Bordered White Banner Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: In 1767 he became vice banner general of the Bordered White Banner Manchus.

sentences.zh: 署雲南永北鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He acted as regional commander of Yongbei in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting regional commander at Yongbei in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He passed away.

sentences.zh: 福隆安，尚高宗女和嘉公主，授和碩額駙、御前侍衛。

translations.literal: Fulong'an married the Gaozong Emperor's daughter Princess Hejia and was appointed prince consort of the first rank and guard of the person.
translations.idiomatic: Fulong'an married Princess Hejia and became prince consort and personal guard.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，擢兵部尚書、軍機處行走，移工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was promoted to Minister of War and served in the Grand Council, then transferred to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In 1768 he became minister of war and grand councillor, then minister of works.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，襲一等忠勇公。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year he inherited the dukedom of Loyal Valor of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In 1770 he inherited the first-rank dukedom of Loyal Valor.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，用兵金川，總兵宋元俊劾四川總督桂林，命福隆安往讞。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, when force was used in Jinchuan, Brigadier Song Yuanjun impeached Sichuan Governor Guilin; Fulong'an was ordered to investigate and try the case.
translations.idiomatic: In 1771 Brigadier Song Yuanjun impeached Governor Guilin; Fulong'an was sent to try the case.

sentences.zh: 福隆安直桂林，抵元俊罪。

translations.literal: Fulong'an vindicated Guilin and convicted Yuanjun.
translations.idiomatic: Fulong'an cleared Guilin and convicted Yuanjun.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，复授兵部尚書，仍領工部。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year he was again appointed Minister of War while still heading Works.
translations.idiomatic: In 1776 he was again minister of war while retaining works.

sentences.zh: 金川平，畫像紫光閣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinchuan was pacified his portrait joined the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，卒，諡勤恪。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he died; posthumous title Qinke.
translations.idiomatic: In 1784 he died with posthumous title Qinke.

sentences.zh: 子丰紳濟倫，初以公主子，命視和碩額駙品秩，授鑲藍旗漢軍副都統、奉宸苑卿。

translations.literal: His son Feng Shenjilun, at first as the princess's son, was ordered treated with the rank of a prince consort of the first rank and appointed vice banner general of the Bordered Blue Banner Han Army and director of the Imperial Parks.
translations.idiomatic: His son Feng Shenjilun, as the princess's son, held princely rank and became vice banner general of the Bordered Blue Banner Han Army and parks director.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，襲爵。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year he inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: In 1784 he inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 累遷兵部尚書，領鑾儀衛。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Minister of War and directed the imperial equipage.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to minister of war and directed the imperial equipage.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶間，再坐事，官終盛京兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing period he was twice punished for offenses and ended as vice president of the Mukden Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jiaqing he was punished twice and ended as Mukden vice president of war.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1807 he passed away.

sentences.zh: 子富勒渾翁珠，襲爵。

translations.literal: His son Fulehunwengzhu inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fulehunwengzhu inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 福長安，自藍翎侍衛累遷至正紅旗滿洲副都統、武備院卿，領內務府。

translations.literal: Fuchang'an rose from guard with the blue feather to vice banner general of the Bordered Red Banner Manchus, director of the Armory, and head of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: Fuchang'an rose from blue-feathered guard to vice banner general of the Bordered Red Banner, armory director, and household head.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十五年，命在軍機處學習行走。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year of Qianlong he was ordered to study and serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In 1780 he was ordered to study on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，台灣平。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year Taiwan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In 1788 Taiwan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 五十七年，廓爾喀平。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year Gurkha was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In 1792 Gurkha was pacified.

sentences.zh: 諸功臣畫像紫光閣，福長安皆與焉。

translations.literal: When meritorious ministers' portraits were painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor, Fuchang'an was among them.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait too was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶三年，俘王三槐，福長安以直軍機處得侯。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaqing, when Wang Sanhuai was captured, Fuchang'an because he served in the Grand Council was made marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In 1798, when Wang Sanhuai was captured, service on the Grand Council won him a marquisate.

sentences.zh: 四年，高宗崩，大學士和珅得罪，仁宗以福長安阿附，逮下獄，奪爵，籍其家。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when the Gaozong Emperor died, Grand Secretary Heshen was condemned; the Renzong Emperor, holding that Fuchang'an had fawned on Heshen, had him arrested, stripped of rank, and his property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In 1799, after Qianlong's death, Heshen fell; Jiaqing arrested Fuchang'an for siding with Heshen, stripped his rank, and seized his property.

sentences.zh: 諸大臣議用朋黨律坐立斬，上命改監候，而賜和珅死，使監福長安詣和珅死所跪視。

translations.literal: The ministers proposed sentencing by the statute on faction, which meant immediate decapitation; the emperor ordered imprisonment awaiting execution instead, and while granting Heshen death ordered Fuchang'an brought to kneel where Heshen died and watch.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers proposed decapitation under the faction law; the emperor commuted it to imprisonment, executed Heshen, and made Fuchang'an watch.

sentences.zh: 旋遣往裕陵充供茶拜唐阿，就遷員外郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent to serve tea at the Yuling mausoleum as baitang'a, then promoted to department secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to serve at the Yuling mausoleum, then made a department secretary.

sentences.zh: 六年，以請還京，奪職，發盛京披甲。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, for asking to return to the capital, he was stripped of office and sent to Mukden as a soldier.
translations.idiomatic: In 1801, for asking to return to Beijing, he was stripped and sent to Mukden as a common soldier.

sentences.zh: 旋自驍騎校屢遷：再為圍場總管，一為馬蘭鎮總兵，再署古北口提督。

translations.literal: Soon from brave-rider secretary he was promoted repeatedly: twice director of the hunting parks, once regional commander of Malan, twice acting commander of Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: From brave-rider secretary he rose twice to hunting-park director, once to Malan commander, twice acting Gubeikou commander.

sentences.zh: 屢坐事譴謫。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly reprimanded and demoted for offenses.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly punished and demoted.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授正黃旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed vice banner general of the Bordered Yellow Banner Manchus.
translations.idiomatic: In 1816 he became vice banner general of the Bordered Yellow Banner Manchus.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1817 he passed away.

sentences.zh: 論曰：高宗初政，寬大而清明，舉國熙熙，樂見太平。

translations.literal: The commentator says: In the Gaozong Emperor's early rule, government was lenient yet clear, and the whole realm rejoiced to see peace.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator writes: In Qianlong's early reign government was lenient and clear, and the realm rejoiced in peace.

sentences.zh: 是時鄂爾泰、張廷玉負夾輔之重，然居中用事為天子喉舌，厥惟訥親，繼之者傅恆也。

translations.literal: At that time Ortai and Zhang Tingyu bore the weight of assisting rule, yet those who held central power as the emperor's voice were Neqin, and after him Fu Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Ortai and Zhang Tingyu assisted the throne, but the emperor's voice in council was first Neqin, then Fu Heng.

sentences.zh: 高宗手詔謂當鄂爾泰在朝，培養陶成，得一訥親；

translations.literal: The emperor's personal edict said that while Ortai was in court, he nurtured and shaped talent until he had one Neqin;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wrote that while Ortai served he nurtured talent until he produced Neqin;

sentences.zh: 訥親在朝，培養陶成，得一傅恆。

translations.literal: while Neqin was in court, he nurtured and shaped talent until he had one Fu Heng.
translations.idiomatic: while Neqin served he nurtured talent until he produced Fu Heng.

sentences.zh: 又謂訥親受恩第一，次則傅恆。

translations.literal: He also said Neqin received favor first, and next Fu Heng.
translations.idiomatic: He also said Neqin received the most favor, then Fu Heng.

sentences.zh: 訥親視師失上指，坐誅，終不沒其勤廉；

translations.literal: Neqin, commanding the army, failed the emperor's intent and was executed, yet in the end his diligence and integrity were not erased;
translations.idiomatic: Neqin failed in command and was executed, yet his diligence and integrity were not forgotten;

sentences.zh: 傅恆再以受降還師，德心孚契，自以其謹慎，非徒藉貴戚功閥重也。

translations.literal: Fu Heng twice returned in triumph after accepting surrender; the emperor's heart was won by trust—this came from his caution, not merely from noble birth and hereditary merit.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng twice returned victorious after accepting surrender; the emperor trusted his caution, not merely his birth and rank.
